info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings File Requests API

params.name: filters[status][value]
params.description:
Pipe-separated list of status values to filter by
(e.g. `CREATED|DONE`). When either
`filters[status][value]` or `filters[status][condition]` is
supplied, both are required.

params.name: filters[status][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the status filter. Must be paired with `filters[status][value]` (see above).

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of elements in the data collection.

params.name: last_evaluated_hash_key
params.description:
Cursor for keyset pagination. Pass the value returned by
the previous page to fetch the next one.

params.name: last_evaluated_range_key
params.description:
Range-key cursor (updated_date timestamp in milliseconds)
for keyset pagination.

items.docs:
Returns the list of file requests created by the authenticated user, optionally filtered by
status. File requests capture the state of async PDF/ZIP report generation jobs.

info.name: Get a file request by ID

items.docs:
Returns a single file request. Used by the apps to poll for the completion of long-running
PDF / ZIP report generation jobs and to retrieve the resulting download URL.
